title: VEGETABLE BROTH
instructions: --Take turnips,  carrots,  potatoes,  beets,  celery, all, or two or three, and chop real fine. Then mix with them an equal amount of cold water, put in a kettle, just bring to a boil, not allowing it to boil for about three or four hours, and then drain off the water. The flavor will be gone from the vegetables and will be in the broth.
